title: An extension of adequate functors is adequate
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file adequate.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a short exact sequence 0 -> F -> G -> H -> 0 of module-valued functors on Alg_A with F and H adequate, the lemma asserts that G is adequate (statement lines 909-915). The proof is a chain of two explicit reductions, each justified by expressing the wanted object as a kernel or cokernel of a map between objects already known adequate: first G is replaced by the case F = M-underlined by passing to (M-underlined + G)/F; then H is replaced by a direct sum of linearly adequate functors using the surjection-from-linear lemma and the pullback G x_H L, and finally G is displayed as the cokernel of the map from a direct sum of copies of F to the sum of the pullbacks, whose components are described element by element (proof lines 917-949). The level is H3: three reductions, each with its kernel/cokernel representation written out, and an explicit description of the maps involved.
